🌳 ELI5 Kata · Google Interview (Idris 1.3, 7 kyu)

Hold a binary tree up to a mirror: every left & right branch swaps places. Hold it up to a 2nd mirror and every branch is right back where it started!

Code + proof: https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/tree/main/katas/7kyu/google-interview

🪞 ELI5 Step 1 (The Leaf):

What happens to a single Leaf(x) at the tip of a branch when you flip it in a mirror?
Nothing! flipTree(Leaf x) = Leaf x.

Flip it twice and it's still Leaf(x). In Idris 1.3, both sides simplify to Leaf(x), so `Refl` ("same thing!") proves the base case.

🌿 ELI5 Step 2 (The Branch):

For Branch(x, L, R):
• 1st flip swaps children → Branch(x, flip R, flip L)
• 2nd flip swaps them back → Branch(x, flip(flip L), flip(flip R))

By induction, L & R bounce back to themselves, and `congBranch x (flipTreeSym l) (flipTreeSym r)` seals the proof!

✅ Totality checked (`%default total`) & verified across 1,370 binary trees!

Idris 1.3 proof: https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/blob/main/katas/7kyu/google-interview/solution.idr
Repo: https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender
